newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan, U.S. to discuss NTT procurement pact Aug 6.
newsitem.headline: Japan, U.S. to discuss NTT procurement pact Aug 6.

text.p: U.S. and Japanese government officials will hold an unofficial meeting on Wednesday in San Francisco to discuss an extension of the bilateral agreement on Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp's international procurement.
The two parties are not expected to reach any conclusions from the meeting in regard to the extension issue, an official of the Posts and Telecommunications Ministry said.
The agreement, which sets guidelines on NTT's international procurement, expires on September 30.
